== World War Server ==

=== '''Jerry’s Death''' ===
On the [[World War Server]], [[Jerry]] finishes a grand speech to the squad—only to step on a landmine that instantly blows him apart. [[Penelope Carter|Penny]] dryly remarks that at least his words were inspiring, while [[Dalia Carter|Dalia]] calls him an idiot for stepping into the open. [[Annie Winters|Annie]] climbs up to peek over the trench, complaining she can barely see. Penny jokes about the tank aiming at them, and an explosion immediately goes off behind them, sending the three tumbling into a pile.

[[Nancy Carter|Nancy]] soon arrives, asking if they’re ready for their big moment. “You bet we are,” Dalia says confidently. Penny assures her that nothing will happen to Dalia this time—she’s improved her healing spells. The two then head off to flank the main squad near the river.

=== '''Annie’s Frustration''' ===
After Nancy gives Dalia and Penny their mission, Annie protests her comms assignment, insisting she can handle combat too. Dalia comforts her, and after some convincing, Nancy lets her join Penny and Dalia on the mission.

=== '''The Trenches''' ===
Not far away, [[Alex Bardot|Alex]] and [[Nova Johnson|Nova]] are positioned in a different trench, fighting against the Wagner Company. Annie radios Nova with coordinates to a huge enemy patrol, but before she can act, [[Maximo]] wipes them out from a distance. Annie sighs, realizing her moment of glory was stolen again. 

=== '''Luna’s Interrogation''' ===
[[File:Luna summons Atomic Twins.png|thumb|Luna summons the Twins.]]
Elsewhere, [[Luna Hernandez|Luna]] steps out into the open, facing two soldiers from the Wagner Company. They raise their guns, but Luna doesn’t flinch—she simply stares. As she closes her eyes, a strange energy fills the air. When she opens them again, her eyes glow, and the soldiers open fire. A bullet flies toward her, but Anastasia suddenly appears and catches it midair. Tatiana materializes behind the men, her presence cold and commanding. The sisters extract the information Luna needs, and Luna thanks them before leaving. 

=== '''Orion Gets the Gem''' ===
The soldier reported that the north, east, and west flanks had fallen, and the south held only with interrupted communications. [[General Wagner]] ordered all remaining units to fortify the bunker. “No one has ever taken the Wagner bunker,” he barked, instructing troops to barricade the entrances. As the soldier ran out to relay orders, Wagner considered the hidden escape route, knowing he might have to leave his men behind.
[[File:Orion takes the 8th Gem.png|thumb|Orion steals the 8th Gem.]]
Orion stepped forward. “Leaving your men behind? That’s selfish,” he said. “Who are you?” Wagner demanded. “I am… Heracles.” Wagner, stunned, asked how he bypassed security. Orion explained he used the sewers and the disloyalty of Wagner’s men. When Wagner asked if he came to kill him, Orion demanded surrender. Wagner agreed but wanted assurances of safety. Orion dropped his gun. Wagner pulled his own, claiming honor means nothing if victory is the goal. Orion warned that the WRE would finish him regardless. Wagner revealed the [[Gem of Doom]], but Orion refused his offer, activated his powers, and stole it. “Your reflexes are slow,” he said, disappearing through a portal.
[[File:Thanatos Wields Hyas.png|thumb|Thanatos slaughters everyone in the bunker.]]
All bunker entrances were secured and reinforcements were on the way, the soldier reported. Wagner demanded they find the traitor and sweep the bunker. [[Thanatos]] crashed through the roof. Wagner recognized him and asked about the gem. Thanatos had no interest in Wagner, only Heracles. Wagner tried to negotiate, boasting of five new gems, but Thanatos drew his sword, [[Hyas]]. Wagner warned he was outnumbered, but Thanatos replied, “Surrounded? I’m surrounded by fear and dead men,” and slaughtered everyone in the bunker. 

== '''Orion and Calypso''' ==
Orion arrived in [[Ogygia]]’s forest and admired its beauty, noticing [[Calypso]] nearby. He reflected on their recent success in acquiring two gems of doom and discussed finding an exit portal. Calypso revealed her frustration with her role as Orion’s “personal maid” and insisted that she participate actively in future missions rather than just facilitating his escapes. She also expressed resentment over how villagers treated her as a tool or weapon.

Orion explained his recent absence and the reason he had been distant, but Calypso revealed she had been tracking him across different worlds, noting that his magical technique still needed improvement. She decided to join Orion on the next mission to gain knowledge of the various realms and hasten her return home.

Orion briefed her on the broader mission: some people who have died in their world continue to exist in Eternum, including Thanatos, and the ultimate goal is to gather all ten gems of doom to uncover the mysteries of these realms. Calypso agreed to meet him for the next mission, opened a portal, and departed, while Orion returned to the real world through the exit portal. 

== '''Orion’s Return''' ==
[[File:Annie, Penelope, Dalia, and Nancy .png|thumb|The girls questioning Orion in the doorway.]]
Back in the real world, Dalia bursts into Orion’s room yelling, “He’s back!” Soon, Nancy, Penny, Dalia, and Annie crowd the doorway, eager to know if Orion secured the Wagner’s Gem of Doom. When he confirms that he did, they cheer and celebrate.

Dalia notices a new Eternum poster on his wall, showing different servers. She suggests returning to [[Ekabar]] for the new “Big Hunt” event. Penny says she wants to check out [[Meiyo]], but Dalia warns her to be careful. Penny teases that Orion will probably go with her anyway.

The group starts debating whether magic or physical abilities are better until Dalia asks Orion to settle it. He laughs it off, and everyone eventually lets him rest. As Nancy leaves, she tells him she’ll shower downstairs so she won’t disturb him. Orion jokes that he wouldn’t mind joining, but Nancy just smiles and replies, “Not today.” 

== '''Orion’s Chat with Idriel''' ==
[[File:Idriel Vision Chapter 6.png|thumb|Idriel in Orion's visions.]]
After everyone leaves Orion’s room, he falls asleep but wakes in a cold, unfamiliar place. A lantern reveals [[Idriel]] sitting on a column, who speaks to him about death, the meaning of life, and the importance of moving forward. She urges him to help those who need him and to “break the chain,” even if he doesn’t fully understand or remember. Orion is then teleported to an exit portal on the [[Rockefeller]] server. 

== Collector's House ==
[[File:Collector's House.png|thumb|Collector's house from outside.]]
In the Rockefeller server, Orion stumbles upon Annie and Nova talking near an exit portal. When he calls their names, he suddenly realizes he’s naked. Mortified, he quickly gets dressed while they laugh it off. Nova brings him up to speed, and the three enter [[The Collector]]’s mansion.

Inside, they meet [[Harley Jones]], the most feared hitwoman in Eternum—until the lights go out. When they flicker back on, a robot named [[Clonk]] stands in the center of the room and announces that The Collector has been murdered. One of them is the killer, and they’ll have to vote to find out who.

During the investigation, Nova uses the alias Delilah Warren and picks up an artifact that splits her into two versions of herself, each with different-colored eyes. The blue-eyed Nova is impulsive and confronts Harley at gunpoint, exposing her fear of blood. After merging back into one, Nova apologizes to Orion. Meanwhile, Annie uncovers clues, finds traces of Polyjuice potion, and realizes [[Gemini]] has been lying about seeing the future. She solves the riddle and exposes the true killer, there was no killer and this was all a game set by The Collector.

Orion is offered a reward—either fifty [[Eternals]] or a powerful artifact. After he chooses, the three head for the exit portal. Before logging off, Annie invites Orion for milk and cookies.  

== '''Annie’s Room''' ==
In her room, Annie and Orion talk about his trip to London over cookies. Annie admits she’s still not ready to play guitar for him, and when she runs out of milk, she realizes [[Carolyn]] drank it all. She sighs, saying the cookies just aren’t the same without it. Orion says he needs to rest before tomorrow’s mission. As he heads for the door, Annie jumps in front of him, leading to their third romance scene. 

== '''Orion Before Alex’s Apartment''' ==
Orion sits on a bench before heading to [https://eternumvn.fandom.com/wiki/Alex%27s_Apartment Alex’s Apartment] and buys Dalia some protein powder for her birthday. Alex texts him, saying she’s sick and asking him to meet her in [[Frontier Trails]] in an hour. Orion decides to get medicine and go anyway. [[Chang Wong|Chang]] approaches, explaining he had to cancel a hiking date with [[Micaela Garcia|Micaela]] due to rain and ran out of money for the movies. Orion gives him $25, prompting Chang to excitedly give Orion a custom shirt before leaving. Orion then receives a text from Penny asking him to tell Luna she looks beautiful with her new hairstyle, which he does before heading to Alex’s. On the way, he runs into [[Axel Bardot|Axel]], and they exchange information about [[Benjamin Dawson|Benjamin]] before going their separate ways. 

== '''Alex’s Apartment''' ==
[[File:Sick Alex & Living Room.png|thumb|Alex being sick and her apartment.]]
Later, Orion visits Alex’s new apartment. She texts him first, saying she’s sick and that he should meet her in Frontier Trails in about an hour. After picking up medicine, he arrives, and she lets him in.

Alex gives him a short tour before they both log into Eternum. 

== Frontier Trails Server ==

=== '''Blackridge''' ===
[[File:Screenshot 20241014 150127.jpg|thumb|The Praetorians kill the bartender.]]
Inside the Frontier Trails server, Orion and Calypso find Dalia in a saloon. She waves them over and orders enough food for everyone—but clearly plans to eat it all herself. Orion has a brief encounter with [[Eva]] before they split up. Calypso heads out to talk to [[The Deputy]] while Alex joins them at the table. Dalia tells them about the history of Blackridge and its lawless frontier. Alex outlines the plan: she’ll investigate the mines, Dalia talks to [[The Sheriff]], and Calypso will go talk to the Sheriff's Deputy. After they split up, [[Praetorian|Praetorians]] arrive at the bar inquiring about a small blue box.

==== Dalia ====
They split up, but Dalia quickly learns the sheriff is a useless drunk who only talks for money. To decide who’ll pay the bribe, she and Orion play rock-paper-scissors—Orion wins. After paying, the sheriff gives them information about El Coyote and one of his men, [[El Coyote|Boone]]. Getting to Boone’s cabin will take a two-hour ride through the desert. Dalia says she’ll go alone, but Orion insists on coming.

==== Calypso ====
Calypso meets with a sheriff’s deputy, and when Orion rejoins her, she’s examining a handgun. Orion mentions a dream where she threatened a man, and Calypso reveals it actually happened—Orion had vanished using unfamiliar magic. Their conversation is interrupted by a gunshot: a [[General Store Clerk]] holds the deputy at gunpoint, accusing him of theft. Orion calms the situation, and the deputy thanks him, offering to take them to the sheriff’s office. As they prepare to leave, the clerk accidentally fires, killing the deputy. Enraged, Calypso disintegrates the clerk. Orion then takes her to a nearby hotel, where she insists he stay to protect her. During her bath, she shares a story about [[Hyril'ar]] and [[Anima the Radiant]], after her story, their interaction turns into a romantic moment.

==== Alex ====
Alex heads to the mines to gather information, and Orion later meets up with her. They discuss the Praetorians before spotting someone matching [[El Coyote (decoy)]]’s description, but Alex accidentally alerts him. To distract the suspect, Orion suggests a kiss, which succeeds—but the person turns out not to be El Coyote. As they prepare to part ways, Orion senses danger and spots a man entering a barn with a [[Jonas|child]] NPC. They intervene, and Orion knocks the man down, revealing a small blue box that controls NPCs. The man demonstrates by releasing the child and then offers Orion 500 Eternals for his freedom. Orion must decide whether to take the money or kill the man. If he kills him, Alex approves and advises leaving the box for the Praetorians.

=== '''The Cabin and the Sandstorm''' ===
Dalia can only find one horse, so she and Orion ride together through the desert. She names the horse Roach and climbs on behind him. The two talk as they ride, but a sudden sandstorm forces them to take shelter in a small cabin.

To pass the time, they start a few games—first Fuck, Marry, Kill, then strip darts, after Orion cleverly suggests swapping games when Dalia tries to corner him with a tough question.

After several rounds, Dalia loses every game, and the tension between them grows into their third romance scene. 

=== '''Boone and the Trap''' ===
Once the storm clears, they decide to head back to Blackridge. Before leaving, they stop by a pond so Roach can drink. As Dalia walks toward Orion, she steps into a Chupacabra trap and is hoisted upside down from a tree. A man approaches, and Orion quickly prepares to fight—but it’s Boone, polite and apologetic. He frees Dalia and explains he’s no longer part of El Coyote’s gang. He offers them information about El Coyote’s location before parting ways. Dalia stays behind with Boone, while Orion rides back to meet Alex and Calypso. 

=== '''The Capture''' ===
Back in Blackridge, Orion finds Alex and fills her in on what Boone told him. Alex tells him to wait while she grabs something from a nearby alley, but when she doesn’t return, Orion goes to look for her. He discovers El Coyote holding Alex captive. Unleashing his demon powers, Orion kills El Coyote and delivers a cold warning to the remaining henchman before letting him go. 

== '''Back in the Real World''' ==
Rain pours outside Alex’s apartment as Orion logs off. Alex tells him he can’t stay the night, but he convinces her to let him hang around. After ordering pizza and watching the swim qualifiers, their banter turns softer, leading into their second romance scene. 

== '''William Arrives''' ==
After their moment together, another knock comes at the door. Alex assumes it’s more pizza—she ordered extra—but when she opens it, [[William Bardot]] stands there. He says he’s there to take care of “business” with Alex. Inside, he and Orion sit across from each other on the couch, the tension in the room thick as the chapter comes to an end.
